subject: STABLE lowering-air-opus: AIR compile time (host) + per-variant base-NIR cache; ready to go behind TEGU_AIR_DIRECT once the frontend hook lands
body: Host x86, in-process warm, min of 3, per record (234 unique CA records; tools/warm_timing.py, runs/warm-all2.jsonl). m2v: translate 13.4 ms (fixed_frag) / 0.8-2.5 ms (blurs etc.) + Mali 3.7 ms (fixed_frag) / 1.7-11.8 ms. AIR (air_to_nir+adapter+pan/bi): fixed_frag 2.9 ms per variant with a warm base (cold first variant ~18 ms), blurs 1.9-3.0 ms (m2v Mali 4.1-7.8), variable_blur 6.4 vs 11.8. Totals: m2v translate 2.73 s + Mali 0.93 s; AIR 0.66 s. New in mali_graphics_air.inc (inc 7bit? see hash): (1) module facts (stage, constant names) cached by blake3, no repeated bitcode parses; (2) folded base NIR cached per (module, entry, function-constant values, varying order), cloned per variant -> warm AIR code+plan identical to cold on 234/234. Function constants are folded during air_to_nir (immediates) then the fold/scratch-forward loop runs once per base. HONEST LIMIT: the adapter still needs the m2v translation's meta (binding plan; the Rust draw planner is m2v-based), so creation still pays m2v translate; AIR replaces only the per-variant Mali compile. Removing the SPIR-V round trip needs an AIR-derived plan in air_bridge.rs (planner owner). Integration handoff (not applied, needs render/compute owners): gpu/build/air-nir-20261028/integration/{air_bridge_air_source.rs,render_pipeline_air_hook.c.txt}. Gates on shared tree: run_host_tests rc=0; integration --candidate only known CA 66/42 (1005 checks); CA host test PASS 47.
